resources.string: Copy sanitized diagnostics
Advanced diagnostics (no songs, labels or paths)
A local learning runtime or decoder is missing.
Check Python 3.13+ and FFmpeg, prepare the local components, then retry.
Learning component download or installation failed.
Check network access and disk space, then retry. Verified downloads are reused.
A learning component failed its integrity check.
Prepare the components again. Unverified components will not run.
A required local recording is unavailable.
Reconnect its music folder or restore the original recording, then retry.
A recording could not be decoded or its format is unsupported.
Check that the original plays correctly and update FFmpeg, then retry.
A decoded excerpt has an unexpected sample length.
Update the app and retry. If it persists, check the original recording is complete.
A decoded excerpt contains invalid samples.
Check or repair the original recording, then retry.
A learning excerpt has insufficient audible content.
Check the recording and silent sections, then retry after repairing the file.
A recording changed during learning.
Wait for file writes to finish, refresh the music folder, then retry.
The learning worker reached its memory limit.
Close memory-intensive apps and retry. Completed analysis is retained.
The learning worker reached its time limit.
Pause playback and reduce system load, then resume. Completed analysis is retained.
The learning worker exited unexpectedly.
Retry once. If it repeats, copy the sanitized diagnostics below.
Learning was cancelled.
Resume learning to reuse completed analysis.
Learning was interrupted when the app or worker exited.
Resume learning. Remote tasks must be restarted from an authorized device or this computer.
This dimension has insufficient usable learning material.
Review its missing material and continue correcting familiar songs in the song list.
The learning result did not pass its effect checks.
Keep the existing recognition and collect more daily corrections without relaxing the checks.
Independent effect-check material or identity review is missing.
Review the material status for this dimension. Existing recognition remains in use.
There is insufficient free disk space.
Provide at least 6 GB free space for learning components, then retry.
This learning run reached its work limit.
Resume learning to reuse completed analysis.
Annotations, permissions or recordings changed during learning.
Confirm the current material and permissions, then restart learning.
Local learning files could not be read or written.
Check disk space and app data directory permissions, then retry.
The historical failure did not retain enough diagnostic information.
Retry when ready. This version records sanitized stages and error codes.
Learning could not finish.
Retry once. If it repeats, copy the sanitized diagnostics below.
